components.css: .ds-demo{border:0;padding:0;font:13px/1.6 Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#535b65)}.ds-demo legend{margin-bottom:10px}.ds-demo div{display:flex;gap:8px}.ds-demo input{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;padding:0}.ds-demo label{display:grid;place-items:center;width:48px;height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d3d7dd);border-radius:6px;font-size:24px;background:var(--surface,#fff);cursor:pointer;transition:translate 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-demo label:hover{translate:0 -3px}.ds-demo input:checked+label{border-color:var(--ink,#121417);background:var(--bg,#f6f7f8)}.ds-demo input:focus-visible+label{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#335d10);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-demo label{transition:none}.ds-demo label:hover{translate:none}}

components.css: .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:22px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#d3d7dd);font:16px/1.6 Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#121417)}.ds-emoji{font:36px/1.2 "Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji",sans-serif;text-align:center}.ds-row a{color:inherit;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}.ds-row a:hover{text-decoration:underline;color:var(--accent,#335d10)}.ds-row a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#335d10);outline-offset:5px}.ds-row small{display:block;color:var(--muted,#535b65);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-row time{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#535b65);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}@media(max-width:500px){.ds-row{grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}.ds-emoji{font-size:30px}.ds-row time{grid-column:2;margin-top:-12px}}

narrative.northStar: A small sideways glance, given room
narrative.overview:
The website amplifies the established reacji-to eyes without replacing their identity. A pale neutral page, direct dark type, and a lime download action give the approved photorealistic blue eyes room to be playful. The homepage is spacious and expressive; public profiles retain a quieter reading rhythm built from open, ruled rows.

This document owns the homepage and public profile surfaces in `reacji-to/reacji-to-web`. The compact blue picker and settings belong to the separate extension repository. It records `worker/home.js`, `worker/pages.js`, `public/logo.png`, `public/icon-512.png`, and `public/fonts/`. The approved logo generation prompt is retained at `docs/logo-generation.txt`. Reviewed homepage evidence is `.impeccable/review/home-desktop.png`, `.impeccable/review/home-mobile.png`, and `.impeccable/review/home-dark.png`. Profile guidance below is source-derived and preserves the incumbent reading mode.
keyCharacteristics: Large transparent blue eyes as the homepage's expressive anchor.
Neutral page surfaces, dark type, lime installation action.
Spacious homepage and compact ruled profile rows.
A small interactive emoji example built from native radio controls and CSS.
Automatic dark mode and reduced-motion-aware hover behavior.

rules.name: Accent
rules.body: Preserve lime for the clear installation action and contextual focus; let the eye artwork provide the blue expression.

dos: **Do** preserve the approved transparent blue-eye artwork and reacji-to wordmark.
**Do** keep the homepage expressive through scale, clear type, and the small emoji interaction.
**Do** retain neutral surfaces, lime download actions, visible focus, and dark-mode mappings.
**Do** preserve the quieter ruled reading layout for public profiles.
**Do** keep the demo's native radio semantics and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: **Don't** recolor the eye asset, add an opaque tile, or replace it with a generic icon.
**Don't** reintroduce the removed homepage profile-search box.
**Don't** spread homepage hero scale or demo cards into profile feed rows.
**Don't** show private reactions or private counts on public profiles.
**Don't** imply the local emoji demo posts a reaction.
